data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 (prior year closing claims outstanding) is taken from the balance sheet prior year column. The report does not present a clear, labelled gross "movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" figure in the notes that is readily extractable from the scanned pages provided. A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes but the individual development cells were not unambiguously machine-extractable from the provided images, so no quantified prior-year development total is reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 2016 column = GBP 155,088k). Prior-year development (gross) not found in a clearly labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note in the scanned images; a gross claims development triangle appears in the notes (approx pages in the high 20s), but the triangle cells could not be reliably transcribed from the images, so prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. Many notes and tables are present but image resolution/rotation and small fonts prevented safe extraction of per-year movement figures and segmental premium breakdown; users should refer to the original PDF for exact numeric PYD and segmental mix.
